worldcombat.skill.brine.summary: Presses a jet of brine at the foe; while the target's HP is at half or less, the salt bites into the wound and the hit is doubled, and the impact leaves a stinging salt pool.
worldcombat.skill.brine.use.0: Double down on a target that is already wounded
worldcombat.skill.brine.use.1: Soak a patch of ground so passers-by come out wet
worldcombat.skill.brine.use.2: Keep the pressure on once a foe drops below half HP
worldcombat.skill.brine.description.0: Deals about %1$s special damage; while the target is at half HP or less that segment is doubled.
worldcombat.skill.brine.description.1: The jet reaches %1$s blocks and travels at about %2$s blocks/tick.
worldcombat.skill.brine.description.2: Leaves a salt pool of radius %1$s blocks for %2$s s; non-allies entering or standing in it are soaked, and a direct hit soaks the target for about %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.brine.press.on: High-pressure mode: power x1.15 and range x1.15, but a smaller, shorter salt pool, +2 ticks windup and +4 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.brine.press.off: Spray mode: a larger, longer salt pool, cheaper windup and cooldown, but power x0.92.
worldcombat.skill.brine.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s windup it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.brine.growth.0: From level %1$s the jet power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.brine.growth.1: From level %1$s power rises to %2$s and the salt pool grows wider.
worldcombat.skill.brine.preference.press: On (high pressure): jet power x1.15 and range x1.15, but a smaller, shorter pool, +2 ticks windup and +4 ticks cooldown, good for finishing the wounded. Off (spray, default): a larger, longer pool, faster and cheaper, good for soaking ground.
worldcombat.skill.brine.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; larger values shoot earlier from farther away.
worldcombat.skill.brine.preference.ai.fi: On: raise this move's priority against targets at half HP or less, where it is doubled; off: rank it as an ordinary ranged attack.
